user.title: Add an LG Aquatic Life device
user.description: Address of the device and an API key. Create the key in the device's web interface: Settings → Sign-in → API keys (pro view).

data_description.host: Host name (e.g. lgal-doser-e4f5.local) or IP address.
data_description.api_key: Starts with lgal_. Shown only once when it is created.

zeroconf_confirm.title: LG Aquatic Life device found
zeroconf_confirm.description: {name} was found at {host}. Create an API key at {url} (Settings → Sign-in → API keys, pro view) and enter it here.

reauth_confirm.title: New API key
reauth_confirm.description: The device at {host} refused the API key. Create a new one at {url} and enter it here.

reconfigure.title: Change address or key
reconfigure.description: Address and API key of the device.

error.setup_required: Finish the initial setup of the device first.
error.not_lgal: This is not an LG Aquatic Life device.
error.unsupported_device: This LG Aquatic Life device is not supported yet.

create_entry.default: **{name}** is set up. Choose an area for **{name}** only: its pump heads below take it over as long as their own area stays empty.

abort.already_configured: The device is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: The new API key is saved.
abort.wrong_device: Another device answers at this address.
abort.not_lgal: This is not an LG Aquatic Life device.

auth_failed.message: The API key was refused. Create a new key in the device's web interface.

setup_required.message: The initial setup of the device is not finished. Finish it in the device's web interface.

unsupported_device.message: This LG Aquatic Life device ({project}) is not supported yet.

no_container.message: The pump has no container size set.

pump_required.message: Select a pump device, or the doser together with a pump number.

unknown_device.message: This is not a device of the LG Aquatic Life integration (or it is not loaded).

container_required.message: Enter the container size or the content.

boost_period_required.message: Enter days or doses for the boost.

err_pump_manual_only.message: The pump is set to manual only.

err_locked.message: The pumps are locked (firmware update running).

err_supply_low.message: The 24 V supply is too low.

err_daily_limit.message: The daily limit would be exceeded.

err_time_invalid.message: The device has no valid time, the daily limit cannot be checked.

err_driver_unavailable.message: The pump driver does not answer.

err_dose_too_small.message: The amount is below the smallest dose.

err_measured_out_of_range.message: The measured amount is implausible (0.25 to 4 times the nominal value).

err_no_calibration_run.message: There is no finished calibration run.

err_collision_lock.message: A lock time to another pump is running; possible from {retry}.

err_queue_full.message: A dose is already waiting for the lock time to end.

err_no_steps.message: The calibration run has no steps.

err_exceeds_daily_limit.message: The schedule exceeds the daily limit.

err_off_grid.message: Times must lie on the schedule grid (e.g. every 5 minutes): {message}

err_invalid_range.message: The end must lie after the start.

err_slots_too_dense.message: Too many doses for this time window.

err_no_slots.message: No scheduled doses in this period (a boost needs a schedule and automatic mode).

err_pump_running.message: Not possible while a pump runs.

err_ota_in_progress.message: A firmware update is already running.

err_no_source.message: The device has no update source.

err_setup_required.message: The initial setup of the device is not finished.
